description: E7 measured-MRL anchor set for capability profiling of the GEMORNA 5'UTR MRL expression oracle (mRNA-side counterpart of the E1 aptamer-oracle profiling). Three families from the Sample et al. 2019 MPRA (EGFP reporter, unmodified RNA, HEK293T): the random 50-nt library (in-training-distribution for MRL models trained on this assay), the varying-length random library, and the varying-length human-endogenous library. Per family: 60 high-MRL + 60 low-MRL screening tiers and a 120-anchor ranking subset evenly spaced across the read-filtered pool's rl ranks (tier overlap flagged in place).
convention: DNA UTRs scored as RNA via T->U by the service

selection_protocol.filter: total_reads >= 1000, ACGT-only, dedupe by utr (max total_reads)
selection_protocol.screening_tiers: top 60 by rl = role 'binder'; bottom 60 = role 'negative'
selection_protocol.ranking_subset: 120 anchors evenly spaced across rl ranks (floor(i*(N-1)/119)), ranking_eligible=true

excluded_subsets.GSM4084997 set=controls: engineered control panel, not a natural-distribution library; only 27 rows pass total_reads>=1000
excluded_subsets.GSM4084997 set=with_uaugs: designed uAUG-introduction perturbation panel; only 17 rows pass total_reads>=1000
excluded_subsets.GSM4084997 set=no_uaugs: designed uAUG-removal perturbation panel; only 17 rows pass total_reads>=1000

known_limitations: Reporter-context MRL: values are mean ribosome load of an EGFP reporter in HEK293T, not endogenous gene expression.
Single assay: both libraries come from one MPRA study (Sample et al. 2019); cross-assay transfer is untested.

sample2019_egfp_random50 is IN-TRAINING-DISTRIBUTION for MRL models trained on this assay (GEMORNA's 5'UTR MRL head was trained on the Sample-2019 random-50 library); a pass there is the expected positive control, not evidence of generalization.
Tiers are relative to each family's own rl distribution; 'binder'/'negative' roles denote high/low-MRL screening poles, not molecular binding.
